title: Mira Iyer：标普盈利预期25%？市场短期无虞
speaker: Mira Iyer

segments.en: The expectations are 20-something percent. Historically, the S&P 500 beats those by about 4-5-6 percent depending on the quarter, which is a pretty punchy goal. Let's call it 25 percent is what largely we expect when to say we mean the market.
segments.zh: 市场预期盈利增长20%以上。历史来看，标普500每季度通常能超额完成4-6个百分点，这个目标相当激进。我们大致认为市场隐含的预期是25%。

segments.en: We think we'll hit that, which probably means good things for markets for the next couple of weeks at least. There's no reason to think that there will be any sort of slowdown given how much money is being spent in AI, given how well the consumer in the U.S. has held up, and frankly the stock market has held up as well.
segments.zh: 我们认为能达到，这对未来几周的市场至少是利好。AI领域投入巨大，美国消费韧性十足，权益市场也表现稳健，没有理由预期会放缓。
